sources.title: Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Vector：多目的地ACK交集與交付語意
related.titleEn: Vector: fan-out acknowledgement intersections and delivery semantics
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付500槽位帳本、版本化映射、未知原因分布與三值回歸樣本，附來源原文而非只留轉換後資料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the 500-slot ledger, versioned mappings, unknown-reason distribution and three-state fixtures, retaining original source records.
related.difference: 為主索引與證據副本分別保留事件ID集合，區分接收、持久化與可讀三種狀態。
related.differenceEn: Keep separate ID sets for the main index and evidence copy, distinguishing acceptance, persistence and queryability.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學語意完整度以已知且正確映射的欄位槽位計算，並非OCSF官方分數或schema合法率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 100筆合成事件，每筆追蹤5個語意欄位，共500槽位；有20槽位無法確認來源值。 已知完整度=(500−20)/500=96%；未知槽位必須保留可查原因。
本課完成條件是兩個指定終端皆可讀，故計算交集；不可將兩端成功數直接相加。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 1000個唯一事件，主端可讀980、副端950；逐ID比較得到交集930，聯集恰為1000。 雙端可讀比例930/1000=93%；70筆仍缺至少一端的讀回證據。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching semantic completeness counts known correctly mapped slots; it is neither an official OCSF score nor schema validity. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. One hundred synthetic events expose five tracked semantic fields each, giving 500 slots; twenty source values are unresolved. Known semantic completeness is (500−20)/500=96%; unresolved slots retain traceable reasons.

This exercise requires readability at both designated endpoints, so completion is an intersection rather than a sum. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Among 1000 unique events, 980 are readable in the primary, 950 in the copy and 930 in both; their union is 1000. Dual-endpoint readability is 93%; seventy events still lack a read-back from at least one endpoint.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Sigma Correlation：滑動窗口邊界與跨租戶分組
related.titleEn: Sigma Correlation: sliding-window boundaries and tenant grouping
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付500槽位帳本、版本化映射、未知原因分布與三值回歸樣本，附來源原文而非只留轉換後資料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the 500-slot ledger, versioned mappings, unknown-reason distribution and three-state fixtures, retaining original source records.
related.difference: 建立tenant、user、time、event_id四欄，明確寫出窗口開閉端點、重複ID策略與分組鍵。
related.differenceEn: Create tenant, user, time and event-ID fields, explicitly defining interval endpoints, duplicate policy and grouping keys.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學語意完整度以已知且正確映射的欄位槽位計算，並非OCSF官方分數或schema合法率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 100筆合成事件，每筆追蹤5個語意欄位，共500槽位；有20槽位無法確認來源值。 已知完整度=(500−20)/500=96%；未知槽位必須保留可查原因。
本課使用(t−W,t]，而非假定所有後端都一致；tenant必須加入分組以避免相同帳號名跨租戶合併。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 租戶A同一user在0、59、60秒各有一筆，租戶B在60秒也有同名user；於t=60、W=60評估。 A窗口為(0,60]，只計59與60兩筆；B事件不得加入A的計數。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching semantic completeness counts known correctly mapped slots; it is neither an official OCSF score nor schema validity. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. One hundred synthetic events expose five tracked semantic fields each, giving 500 slots; twenty source values are unresolved. Known semantic completeness is (500−20)/500=96%; unresolved slots retain traceable reasons.

This exercise uses (t−W,t], without assuming universal backend behavior; tenant belongs in the grouping key. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Tenant A has same-user events at 0,59,60 seconds; tenant B has a same-named user at 60; evaluate at t=60 with W=60. A’s window is (0,60], counting only the events at 59 and 60; tenant B contributes nothing to A.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
